items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: And there was another one from Buffalo, I think of it, named Hank DiMico, who also played around in quite a few bands and was rated very well.

ctx.x: That's right. And there was another one from Buffalo, I think of it, named Hank DiMico, who also played around in quite a few bands and was rated very well. He was the Buffalo boy, Hank DiMico.
I don't know what's happened to him then.
